vulnerabilities.description: buildHorizonArtifactInventory in packages/graph-core/src/inventory.ts uses path.resolve instead of realpathSync on symlinks, failing to detect symlinks resolving outside the repository root.
assembleGraphSnapshotV2 in packages/graph-core/src/build.ts overrides coverage.scope instead of rejecting CoverageManifests belonging to mismatched horizons, violating scenario 1.1.
analyzeHorizonImpact in packages/graph-core/src/impact.ts accumulates path explanations without a truncation bound on high-fanout cyclic graphs.

edgeCasesMissed: assembleGraphSnapshotV2 does not reject mismatched coverage manifest scope from another horizon before publishing.
buildHorizonArtifactInventory does not use realpathSync to detect symlinks pointing outside the repository root.
analyzeHorizonImpact lacks bounded size cap on explanations collection during high-fanout traversal.
